attempts.text:
Satish Chitturi
satish.chitturi79@gmail.com 9392025548 Hyderabad
Profile
Risk & Investment Analytics professional with experience supporting portfolio risk reporting, exposure analysis, data validation, 
reconciliations, and risk analytics across equity, fixed income, and derivative instruments. Strong understanding of investment risk 
concepts including Value-at-Risk (VaR), portfolio exposures, benchmark concepts, duration, beta, sensitivity analysis, stress 
testing, and derivatives risk. Proficient in SQL, Python, Power BI,  and Excel  for data extraction, validation, analysis, reporting 
automation, and data-quality controls. Familiar with Bloomberg PORT, Aladdin, FactSet, and Snowflake concepts and workflows.
Technical & Quantitative Skills
	•Investment Risk & Portfolio Analysis: Investment Risk Concepts, Portfolio Exposures, Benchmark Concepts, Portfolio & Benchmark 
Analysis, Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall, Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis, Duration, Beta, Sensitivity Analysis

	•Financial Instruments & Markets: Equities, Fixed Income, OTC Derivatives, Equity Derivatives, Options, Swaps, Financial Markets

	•Risk Reporting & Data Quality: Portfolio Risk Reporting, Risk Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Variance Analysis, Data Quality 
Checks, Exception Investigation, Reporting Controls, Stakeholder Query Resolution

	•Programming & Analytics: SQL, Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Advanced Excel, VBA, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx

	•Investment Technology — Familiarity/Knowledge: Bloomberg PORT, Bloomberg, Aladdin, FactSet

Professional Experience
Risk Management & Reporting Analyst
Patha's Wealth Management & Associates | Hyderabad, India
	•Produce periodic and customized risk management, portfolio performance, and investment 
analytics reports for client portfolios and internal stakeholders within defined SLA timelines.

Apr 2024 – Present
	•Analyze portfolio exposures and key investment risk measures, including VaR, duration, beta, 
and sensitivity metrics across equity, fixed income, and derivative instruments.

	•Validate portfolio, transaction, position, and valuation data for completeness, accuracy, 
consistency, and reporting readiness.

	•Perform multi-source data reconciliations, variance analysis, and exception investigation to 
identify and resolve data-quality issues affecting risk and portfolio reporting.

	•Develop and maintain automated reporting and validation processes using SQL, Python, Excel, 
and Power BI to improve reporting efficiency and data accuracy.

	•Investigate risk analytics and reporting issues, coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders, 
and document procedures, controls, and standard operating processes.

	•Respond to stakeholder and ad hoc requests for portfolio, exposure, risk, and performance 
information while maintaining accuracy and agreed reporting timelines.

Applied Market Risk & Quant Finance Projects
	•Market Risk – Value-at-Risk (VaR):Developed Historical VaR models using 1,000+ trading days of returns for an equity trading-
style portfolio.Performed backtesting, exception analysis, and breach monitoring aligned with Basel market risk principles. 
Analyzed sensitivity of portfolio VaR to changes in volatility and correlations.

	•Derivatives Pricing: Priced European options on SPY using Black–Scholes, Binomial, and Monte Carlo models. Implemented 
Monte Carlo simulations for Asian and Barrier options under varying volatility assumptions. Computed option Greeks to assess 
price sensitivity and risk exposures.

	•Portfolio Risk & Performance: Constructed a multi-asset equity portfolio (JPM, Morgan Stanley) and evaluated risk-adjusted 
performance. Computed Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, maximum drawdown, and return distributions. Analyzed portfolio behavior 
during the COVID-19 stress period to assess downside risk characteristics.

Education
	•Master of Science in Financial Engineering - WorldQuant University | Expected Dec 2026

	•B.Com – Finance & Accounts – Osmania University, Hyderabad

Certifications
FRM (Financial Risk Manager) Part I – In Progress, GARP
Microsoft Excel Associate (2019) | Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) | Alteryx Designer Core |
mailto:satish.chitturi79@gmail.com
tel:9392025548
